A_target.statement:
Let $\FF$ be an [[Definition:Antichain|antichain]] in $\powerset {\set {1, \ldots, n} }$.
Then:
:$\card \FF \le \dbinom n {\floor {n / 2} }$
with equality for the family of all $\floor {n / 2}$-subsets.

B_source.statement:
For every antichain $\FF$ in $\powerset {\set {1, \ldots, n} }$:
:$\displaystyle \sum_{A \mathop \in \FF} \frac 1 {\dbinom n {\card A} } \le 1$

derived.the weighted inequality: a bound on the number of members

object_map.reformulation: Bound every weight below by the smallest one, which belongs to the middle layer.

validity_conditions: The binomial coefficients C(n, k) are maximal at k = floor(n/2).
The middle layer is itself an antichain, giving equality.
proof_plan:
Hence each term of the source sum is at least $\dfrac 1 {\dbinom n {\floor {n / 2} } }$, and:
:$\dfrac {\card \FF} {\dbinom n {\floor {n / 2} } } \le 1$
